title.zh: 概率与频率 · 大数定律
title.en: Probability & frequency · the law of large numbers

description.zh: 概率是一次结果出现的可能性大小，频率是真做很多次后它实际出现的比例；次数越多，频率越稳定地围着概率打转，但每一次仍然随机，连出几次红也不会让下一次“该轮到”别的颜色。
description.en: Probability is how likely one outcome is; frequency is the fraction of times it actually happens over many trials. The more trials, the more tightly the frequency hugs the probability — yet every single trial stays random, and a run of reds does not make another colour “due”.

zh: 连开几次红，下次该开黑了吗
抛硬币一定一半正面吗
en: after several reds, is black due
does a coin always land heads half the time

label.zh: 频率给概率一个可检验的意思
label.en: Frequency gives probability a testable meaning

reason.zh: 单次结果说不准，但大量重复后频率会稳定在概率附近；概率模型说的正是这种长期频率，也因此能拿实验数据去检验。
reason.en: A single outcome cannot be predicted, but over many repeats the frequency settles near the probability; a probability model speaks about exactly this long-run frequency, which is why it can be checked against data.

reason.zh: 频率随次数增加收拢到概率，蒙特卡洛正是反过来利用这一点：用大量随机试验的频率或平均值去估计概率、面积和期望，误差随 1/√n 缩小。
reason.en: Because frequencies close in on probabilities as trials grow, Monte Carlo runs the idea backwards: it estimates probabilities, areas and expectations from the frequencies or averages of many random trials, with error shrinking like 1/√n.

label.zh: 频率的波动范围就是区间
label.en: The spread of a frequency is an interval

reason.zh: 转 n 次时，频率约有 95% 的机会落在 p ± 1.96√(p(1−p)/n) 之内；把这个范围反过来套在观测到的频率上，就是比例的置信区间。
reason.en: With n spins the frequency lands within p ± 1.96√(p(1−p)/n) about 95% of the time; turning that band around the observed frequency gives a confidence interval for a proportion.

question.zh: 连续开了五次红，下一次是不是更可能开黑？
question.en: After five reds in a row, is black more likely next time?

ask.zh: 只挑出“前面连续五次正面”的那些情形，下一次正面的比例是多少？
ask.en: Among only the runs that began with five heads, what fraction showed heads next?

ask.zh: 硬币记得住之前的结果吗？独立是什么意思？
ask.en: Does a coin remember earlier results? What does independence mean?

reveal.zh: 每次转盘或抛币相互独立，过去的结果不会改变下一次的概率；“该轮到了”是赌徒谬误。大数定律说的是比例在很多次之后趋于稳定，靠的是新结果把早先的偏差稀释掉，而不是补偿回来。
reveal.en: Each spin or toss is independent, so past results do not change the next probability; “it’s due” is the gambler’s fallacy. The law of large numbers says the proportion steadies over many trials because new results dilute an early imbalance, not because they compensate for it.
